facts.business: Asian Hotels (West) Limited owns and operates the Hyatt Regency, Mumbai hotel.

auditor.name: J.C. Bhalla & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Adverse opinion due to: 1) Uncertainty over classification of Rs. 39,000 lakhs received from Saraf Group as borrowing or advance for sale of Hyatt Regency, Mumbai; non-compliance with Section 180(1)(a) and charge filing requirements; potential applicability of Ind AS 105. 2) Non-recognition of interest expense of Rs. 7,845.07 lakhs and reimbursement expenses of Rs. 1,598.39 lakhs claimed by Saraf Group. 3) Unreconciled balance of Rs. 242.64 lakhs in borrowings. 4) Material uncertainty regarding going concern as current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 42,432.87 lakhs.

key_risks: Classification uncertainty of Rs. 39,000 lakhs from Saraf Group as borrowing vs advance for asset sale
Non-compliance with Section 180(1)(a) and charge filing requirements
Potential misapplication of Ind AS 105 for assets held for sale
Non-recognition of claimed interest expense (Rs. 7,845.07 lakhs) and reimbursement expenses (Rs. 1,598.39 lakhs)
Unreconciled borrowing balance of Rs. 242.64 lakhs
Material uncertainty on going concern: current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 42,432.87 lakhs
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with Saraf Group/Novak Hotels Private Limited involving Rs. 39,000 lakhs funding for Hyatt Regency, Mumbai under Framework Agreement; promoters are on the Board and informed Company the amount is a loan disclosed as borrowings.
